page_title: GEN 0-0 TOR | Genoa v Torino 07/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Genoa comes to nothing.
90+4' Adrien Tameze (Torino) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
90+3' The resulting set piece from Torino is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Patrizio Masini (Genoa) was quite harsh and Livio Marinelli didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' The Yann Karamoh (Torino) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Livio Marinelli rules it out for a handball.
88' Paolo Vanoli has decided to make a change. Adrien Tameze (Torino) replaces Karol Linetty.
87' Morten Thorsby just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Patrizio Masini (Genoa) replaces him.
87' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
84' A corner kick by Genoa is thwarted by the well prepared Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino).
82' Adam Masina (Torino) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
81' It's time for a substitution. Alieu Njie (Torino) comes on in place of Antonio Sanabria.
81' Substitution. Marcus Pedersen makes way for Valentino Lazaro (Torino).
78' Patrick Vieira has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mario Balotelli (Genoa) replacing Andrea Pinamonti.
77' Saul Coco (Torino) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
75' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:2.

72' Genoa slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
69' Substitution. Yann Karamoh (Torino) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Che Adams walks off.
69' Paolo Vanoli has decided to substitute Mergim Vojvoda and he is replaced by Borna Sosa (Torino).
67' Substitution. Milan Badelj walks off the pitch and Vitinha (Genoa) comes on as a substitute.
66' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Genoa, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
64' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Torino.
63' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Torino, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
62' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) tackles a bit over-zealously and Livio Marinelli blows for a foul. Torino will take a free kick.

60' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Morten Frendrup (Genoa) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Vanja Milinkovic-Savic easily catches the ball.
57' Genoa fail to score from a corner as Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino) leaps to collect the ball.

56' Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball goes out for a corner. Genoa can continue in their attacking effort.

54' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Genoa are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
52' Genoa couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
51' Karol Linetty (Torino) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for a foul. Genoa have a free kick.
48' Torino failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

48' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Che Adams (Torino) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The referee points to the corner flag and Torino will take a corner.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Milan Badelj (Genoa) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) has tested the patience of referee Livio Marinelli and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
45' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
43' Wonderful movement by Torino. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
41' The shot by Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Nicola Leali.

38' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) attempts to test the goalkeeper after collecting a cross inside the penalty area. Luck doesn't appear to be on his side today as his attempt rattles the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
35' Saul Coco (Torino) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
34' The corner is swung in but Genoa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

33' That's unlucky! Morten Frendrup (Genoa) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Genoa force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

30' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the right side of the goal. Nicola Leali displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
27' The Torino players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

24' Milan Badelj (Genoa) receives a nice lofted pass and rips a snap shot from the edge of the box. His kick misses the goal and flies high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
23' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) produces a cross from the resulting free kick far from the goal, but there's no one to really attack the ball and the goalkeeper gathers easily.
21' 0:0 – the total goal attempt statistics.
19' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
17' Morten Thorsby receives a sweet cross inside the box from Fabio Miretti (Genoa), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
16' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
14' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) launches a cross from the corner, but Nicola Leali is alert to thwart the effort.
13' Genoa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
11' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) is penalised for a foul. Livio Marinelli had a clear view and blows his whistle.

9' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
8' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Torino will take a throw-in.
5' The ball is cleared after Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

3' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is out of play. Genoa will have a throw-in.
2' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa).
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Torino will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Livio Marinelli.
